name: LabCanvas Figure Editor / MolDraw
tierReason: Implemented molecular drawing and editable figure integration support publication-oriented 2D documents, with paid exports and documented vector output.
summary: Browser-based molecule and reaction drawing integrated with editable scientific figures.

license.text: Proprietary service; free accounts allow three designs, while exports require LabCanvas Pro.

price.text: 2026-11-05: Free for three designs; Pro US$19/month or US$199/year, before applicable taxes.

engine.rendering: HTML canvas 2D and a custom SVG serializer in MolDraw
engine.chemistry: Indigo WebAssembly, in-house structure logic, and OpenChemLib for 3D conformers

bonds-core.note: Manual drawing with single, double and triple bond tools.

stereo-bonds.note: Solid wedge, hashed wedge and wavy bond rendering.

special-bonds.note: Dative and dotted hydrogen bonds have drawing handlers.

rings.note: Dedicated benzene and other ring tools.

conformers.note: Dedicated chair and boat cyclohexane placement commands.

chains.note: Dragging generates zigzag chain coordinates at the configured bond length.

templates.note: Common group templates accompany the ring tools.

abbreviations.note: ExpandAlias converts recognized group labels into explicit atoms.

atom-labels.note: Element, formal charge, isotope and alias editing commands.

radicals.note: Lone-pair and radical tools update individual atoms.

keyboard-drawing.note: Select an atom, then type an element or group abbreviation.

selection-tools.note: Lasso selection, rotation, scaling and horizontal/vertical reflection.

perspective.note: 3D cleanup creates a canvas pose that users can rotate.

reaction-arrows.note: Forward, equilibrium and retrosynthesis arrows with reagent text.

mechanism-arrows.note: Editable curved electron-flow arrows support full and single-electron heads.

reaction-data.note: Reaction SMILES imports and exports chemically represented reaction sides.

atom-mapping.note: Indigo automapping returns atom maps applied to the drawing.

orbitals.note: Placeable s, p, d and dz2 orbital graphics.

rich-text.note: Canvas text supports font selection and subscript/superscript character ranges.

shapes.note: Figure editor provides editable shapes, pen paths and freehand curves.

align.note: Figure editor supports alignment and even horizontal or vertical spacing.

groups.note: Figure editor has Group and Ungroup commands.

cleanup.note: Structure cleanup is part of the documented drawing workflow.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript local cleanup); optional Indigo (WebAssembly layout/clean2d)

journal-styles.note: ACS 1996, RSC, Nature and other drawing presets.

custom-styles.note: Bond and font preferences persist in local browser storage.

color.note: Selection color commands target atoms, bonds and canvas objects.

pages.note: Figure artboards; multipage documents use the separate Slides app.

pictures.note: Image files and pasted raster images become canvas image objects.

tlc-tables.note: Figure editor provides editable tables with scientific styles.

valence-check.note: Local heuristic flags valence, charge and stereo problems.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript valence, charge and stereo heuristics)

stereo-perception.note: Native stereo tags and Indigo CIP fallback supply R/S and E/Z.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript R/S and E/Z assignment); Indigo (WebAssembly calculateCip fallback)

formula-mass.note: Indigo computes molecular formula, molecular weight and monoisotopic mass.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript formula/mass calculations); Indigo (WebAssembly calculated properties)

properties.note: Indigo computes logP, pKa and molar refractivity.

engine.library: Indigo (WebAssembly logP, pKa and molar refractivity)

name-to-structure.note: PubChem name lookup opens matching structures for editing; network required.

engine.library: PubChem web service (PUG REST name lookup)

structure-to-name.note: PubChem IUPAC lookup only; unindexed structures cannot receive generated names.

engine.library: PubChem web service (PUG REST SMILES-to-IUPACName lookup)

nmr-prediction.note: NMR menu calls an always-null extension context; predictor is unwired.

markush.note: R/R1/R2 aliases and generic query bond tools.

polymers.note: Polymer presets create atom-linked repeating units with editable SRU brackets.

database-lookup.note: Search PubChem by name and import an editable structure.

engine.library: PubChem web service (PUG REST and autocomplete)

model-3d.note: The same molecule can be turned in a 3D view.

crystals.note: Separate LabCanvas 3D Studio opens CIF/POSCAR files; vendor claim.

cdxml.note: Native atom/bond import and export; Pro downloads; fidelity untested.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript native CDXML atom/bond import and export)

cdx.note: Indigo binary import/export; Pro downloads; fidelity untested.

mol-sdf.note: MOL read/write; Pro exports; SDF import reads first record only.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript MOL parser/writer and first-record SDF import); Indigo (WebAssembly optional MOL V3000 conversion)

smiles.note: Paste SMILES and read drawing SMILES; file exports require Pro.

engine.library: In-house (JavaScript native SMILES parser/writer); optional Indigo (WebAssembly conversion/layout)

inchi.note: Indigo import/export and clipboard conversion; Pro downloads.

rxn.note: Indigo import/export; reaction layout fidelity unverified; Pro downloads.

svg-export.note: Custom serializer emits vector SVG; downloads require Pro.

pdf-export.note: Pro; vector PDF through Figure editor; vendor claim.

png-export.note: Pro; physical width and 300/600 dpi export settings.

mcp-agents.note: Pro; MCP server supports figure editing; vendor claim.

ai-assistant.note: Pro; built-in assistant edits figure objects; vendor claim.

caveats: An account is required; the free plan permits three designs and excludes downloads and exports.
Standalone MolDraw PDF output is raster; vector PDF requires the Figure editor.
NMR's menu is unwired in the inspected build; interactive usability was not tested.

builtOn.note: Vendor documentation reviewed does not establish canvas provenance or chemistry dependencies.

plans.name: LabCanvas Pro
plans.price: 2026-11-06: US$19/month or US$199/year; applicable taxes extra
